set.body:
Supporting track: Run. Owner task.

Acceptance
1. Two labs are named, each with one steward and one researcher who agree to take part in rehearsals in December and January.
2. The pilot study is named (it may be the IN1 study), with a clear answer on whether its ethics protocol permits sharing de-identified data with the second lab. If it does not, the real study stays inside its own lab and the two-lab rehearsal uses public data.
3. A one-paragraph description of the pilot (de-identified research data, inside the institute network, named users) is sent to the privacy office or the research ethics office, or deliberately held until the pitch. Either choice is recorded here.
4. Wanted, not blocking: one real EEG, MEG or eye-tracking dataset from either lab, already in BIDS, to bring in through IN4, so the pitch shows the institute's own non-MRI data.
set.title: RUN0: Choose the pilot study, the two labs, and confirm the ethics position
